reviewed_routes.interpretation: Coordinator adds finite source-contract and typeahead paths. Source-contract uses fixed Node script commands and fixed -e inspector strings, removes RC_ environment and launches Git for metadata; it is actual current inspector execution, not execution of git show blobs. Typeahead invokes fixed build/Karma paths in a staged tree with existing node_modules; see earlier census for environment and evidence checks.

Scenario table adds literal focus-reinsert subprocess selected by fixed list; normal slice invokes Node with tarball and scenario arguments; npm install in new caller retains literal approved install options and npmToolingOptions. Under RC_CHECK_ID browser-matrix, slice takes dynamic import of current browser-matrix-acceptance instead of normal table; downstream dispatch and environment remain distinct scope.

Plan reclassified input to support with changed bytes, still read as actual runtime configuration: adds platform-specific linux-x64/linux-arm64 pins. Coordinator fetches exact selected URL, verifies archive and node execution version/platform, passes resolved npm CLI via environment; packed consumer floor wrapper launches selected Node with npm CLI and fixed install argv. Network/download is a source-described route, not performed by this review.

Historical blobs read using git cat-file are data; two current, physically read helpers are hash checked then compile/exec loaded and reread. These are executable current source, unlike historical comparisons; their examined child calls read Git blobs. Runtime effects outside inspected paths remain unresolved.

New isolated Sass expected calculation executes verified current bootstrap bytes via Node --eval, then runs manifest-selected snapshot entry with Node permission flags and a reduced environment. Manifest selects operation and verified file closure; current repository and dependency bytes are inputs, snapshot entry is executed, not merely metadata. No npm launch established in examined path.

CI adds actual Node source-lifecycle tests. They import selected current peers and execute generated/transpiled current test modules; dialog motion also reads historical Git content as comparison. Source-only inspection is not a runtime result.

Source qualification tools use Git historical images as comparison data and finite current checks; checker proposal separately starts current verifier. The historical blobs are not npm command execution by these paths. Parent final patch/source review covers narrower guard details.

Coordinated browser acceptance dynamically imports current acceptance module; it calls executeIds and ripple hydration replay and launches current browser-surface-families with Chrome environment. Required-cells, ripple replay and surface-family npm invocations are in the prior install/pack roster and use npmToolingOptions. This path is distinct from ordinary slice scenario list.

preconditions_and_limits: The repository .npmrc, npm-tooling-options.mjs, toolchain-lock.json, chainman.toml and justfile are byte-identical between e0418ab and reviewed HEAD; identical files alone do not determine all call-site behavior.
Prior 22-row install/pack roster plus separately documented version routes are bounded historical evidence, not all npm calls; see report.json and npm-version-addendum.json.

Inspected new focus caller uses same literal install options and npmToolingOptions; floor install continues through helper before wrapper remaps executable. No blanket preservation conclusion for other dynamically computed launches.
Floor plan bytes and classification changed; treating all support records as inert would omit actual runtime configuration.

Pattern hits include imports, comments, regular-expression exec and fixture programs and have not all been semantically reviewed. Dependency graphs and unobserved computed/shell/evaluated routes remain unresolved.
